author: NASS
description:
Travel back to New York City in 1902 and witness one of the most extraordinary engineering achievements in history the birth of the modern skyscraper. This rare historical film captures fearless workers, massive steel structures, horse-drawn wagons, busy streets, and the rapid transformation of Manhattan into the world's most iconic skyline.

Experience the construction of New York's earliest skyscrapers as if it had been filmed today, and discover how these remarkable buildings forever changed the future of architecture and urban life.

If you enjoyed this restoration, please Like, Comment, and Subscribe to support future historical restoration projects.

📽️ Technologies & Techniques Used:
• Advanced video restoration
• New semantic colorization only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
• Manually colorized keyframes (to establish accurate ambiance and color consistency (not historically accurate)
• Advanced frame reconstruction to 4K
